explanation_full: The Decision Tree (DT) model's predictive performance is summarized by several diagnostics. The model achieved an R2 score of 0.5605, which indicates its proportion of variance explained. The Root Mean Square Error (RMSE) was 0.1755, and the Mean Absolute Error (MAE) was 0.1086. Additionally, the correlation between predicted and actual values was 0.787161, and the linear fit slope was 0.802783. These metrics provide a comprehensive view of the DT model's fit and error magnitude.
